tools.name: team_whoami
tools.title: zn Team: who am I
tools.description: Shows the zn Team organization and the org admin token this zn-gate uses (prefix, scopes, expiry, the role of its creator), the agent write mode and the confirmation channels available here. Never shows the token itself.

tools.name: team_org_get
tools.title: zn Team: organization
tools.description: Gets the zn Team organization: name, plan and subscription status, seats and seats used, current policy version.

tools.name: team_members_list
tools.title: zn Team: members
tools.description: Lists the members of the zn Team organization (user, role, joined) and the pending invitations.

tools.name: team_installs_list
tools.title: zn Team: installs
tools.description: Lists the zn-gate installs that joined the organization: agent, OS, zn-gate version, last seen and audit records.

tools.name: team_policy_get
tools.title: zn Team: policy
tools.description: Gets the current organization policy with the index and rule_hash of each rule (needed by team_policy_propose), the public signing key id and the version history.

history.description: How many past versions to list.

tools.name: team_audit_query
tools.title: zn Team: audit events
tools.description: Queries the zn-gate audit events of the organization (metadata only: secret names, agents, hosts and decisions, never values).

since.description: Start: a relative age (30m, 24h, 7d) or a date or date-time. Default 30d.

until.description: End: a date or date-time. Default now.

tools.name: team_audit_summary
tools.title: zn Team: audit summary
tools.description: Counts of zn-gate audit events per day, agent and decision for the last N days.

tools.name: team_activity_list
tools.title: zn Team: admin activity
tools.description: Lists the organization activity log: every admin action and every request made with an org token (who, which token or client, what, result).

since.description: Start: a relative age (30m, 24h, 7d) or a date or date-time.

token_id.description: Only events of this org token (tok_...).

tools.name: team_audit_export
tools.title: zn Team: export audit events
tools.description: Downloads an export of the audit events (CSV or JSON) to a file in ~/zn-exports, checks its SHA-256 against the server and returns the file path, hash and row count. The contents are not returned.

since.description: Start: a relative age (30m, 24h, 7d) or a date or date-time.

tools.name: team_changes_list
tools.title: zn Team: pending changes
tools.description: Lists proposed changes (pending by default) with their summary, class, status and who requested them.

tools.name: team_change_status
tools.title: zn Team: change status
tools.description: Gets one proposed change and its status (pending, applied, rejected, cancelled, expired, failed).

tools.name: team_member_invite
tools.title: zn Team: invite a member
tools.description: Invites a person to the organization (uses a paid seat). Proposes the change. A person must approve it outside the conversation; this tool cannot approve on its own. Changes that open access are approved only in the zn dashboard. Inviting an admin is approved only in the dashboard, by the owner.

note.description: Why the change is requested. Shown to the approver, marked as unverified text written by the agent.

tools.name: team_invitation_revoke
tools.title: zn Team: revoke an invitation
tools.description: Revokes a pending invitation. Proposes the change. A person must approve it outside the conversation; this tool cannot approve on its own. Changes that open access are approved only in the zn dashboard.

note.description: Why the change is requested. Shown to the approver, marked as unverified text written by the agent.

tools.name: team_member_remove
tools.title: zn Team: remove a member
tools.description: Removes a member from the organization. Proposes the change. A person must approve it outside the conversation; this tool cannot approve on its own. Changes that open access are approved only in the zn dashboard.

note.description: Why the change is requested. Shown to the approver, marked as unverified text written by the agent.

tools.name: team_member_set_role
tools.title: zn Team: change a member role
tools.description: Changes the role of a member. Proposes the change. A person must approve it outside the conversation; this tool cannot approve on its own. Changes that open access are approved only in the zn dashboard. Promoting to admin is approved only in the dashboard, by the owner.

note.description: Why the change is requested. Shown to the approver, marked as unverified text written by the agent.

tools.name: team_install_revoke
tools.title: zn Team: revoke an install
tools.description: Revokes a zn-gate install: it stops receiving the organization policy and can no longer upload audit events. Proposes the change. A person must approve it outside the conversation; this tool cannot approve on its own. Changes that open access are approved only in the zn dashboard.

note.description: Why the change is requested. Shown to the approver, marked as unverified text written by the agent.

tools.name: team_policy_propose
tools.title: zn Team: propose a policy change
tools.description: Proposes typed operations on the organization policy, applied in order on base_version (get it, and each rule index and rule_hash, with team_policy_get). Proposes the change. A person must approve it outside the conversation; this tool cannot approve on its own. Changes that open access are approved only in the zn dashboard. The server decides which operations only tighten; anything else needs the dashboard.

base_version.description: Policy version the operations apply to.

secret.description: Vault secret NAME, NAME prefix followed by *, or * for every secret.

agents.description: zn-gate agent ids (claude-code, codex, cursor, opencode) or *.

index.description: Rule position in the current policy (team_policy_get rules_with_hash).

rule_hash.description: rule_hash of that rule in base_version (team_policy_get).
